standard_reporting_year.leap_rule: 29-Feb is expected only if present in the real calendar between reporting start and end

validation_status.negative_fixtures: 95 DEFINED; executable run deferred to Design 6

readiness_states.meaning: Workbook-level schema/control failure prevents trustworthy routing/canonical calculation.
readiness_states.user_message: Workbook setup needs correction before calculation can start.

readiness_states.meaning: Affected structure/series/network/person-day claim has a blocking input or scientific validation error.
readiness_states.user_message: This item cannot be calculated until the listed issue is fixed.

readiness_states.meaning: All calculation prerequisites pass and no calculation warning applies.
Calculation prerequisites pass but a non-blocking method/evidence/plausibility warning exists.
readiness_states.user_message: Can be calculated; review the warning before certified reporting.

readiness_states.meaning: Recognized route intentionally has no approved automatic calculation method.
readiness_states.user_message: Recognized, but not calculated under the current approved method.

readiness_states.meaning: Recognized record is excluded from automatic compliant water-potential totals.
readiness_states.user_message: Recorded for audit/reporting but excluded from automatic water totals.

readiness_algorithm.name: Workbook gate
readiness_algorithm.logic: If any WORKBOOK_BLOCK rule fails => workbook_not_ready. Do not execute official formulas.

readiness_algorithm.name: Route terminal states
readiness_algorithm.logic: Governance/subsurface => excluded. Partly-lined => hold. Continue person-days independently.

readiness_algorithm.name: Scoped prerequisites
readiness_algorithm.logic: Evaluate only rules applicable to the resolved route/method.

readiness_algorithm.name: Propagation
readiness_algorithm.logic: Record blocker affects one record; rainfall blocker propagates to linked simulation windows; cascade blocker propagates only through affected network.

readiness_algorithm.name: Warning logic
readiness_algorithm.logic: If no blocker but one or more WARNING/ASSURANCE_DOWNGRADE applies => ready_with_warning.

readiness_algorithm.name: Calculation QA
readiness_algorithm.logic: After calculation, numerical safeguard failure converts affected result to not_ready and suppresses official result.

readiness_algorithm.name: Assurance separation
readiness_algorithm.logic: Supporting evidence gaps do not rewrite a valid numerical value; E07 assigns assurance separately.

readiness_algorithm.name: Aggregation
readiness_algorithm.logic: E08 aggregates status buckets separately and excludes hold/excluded from compliant water totals.

scope_matrix.propagation: No official formulas run until fixed.

scope_matrix.example: Bad geometry, base area, route input, person-day claim
Duplicate/missing/invalid rainfall or invalid source selection
scope_matrix.propagation: Only linked WTR-111 structures whose simulation window is affected are blocked.
Only dependent cascade network is blocked.
No water result; other modules continue.
Excluded from water totals; person-days/evidence continue.
Calculation continues; E07 assurance becomes provisional/evidence-pending.
Source results stay intact; aggregate is withheld until corrected.

route_gates.standard_required_inputs: Structure + Technical geometry + Catchment + linked daily Rainfall + Hydro Group + Verified Base Area + 12 monthly evaporation values
route_gates.advanced_only: VAL-064..066 if Advanced stage-area is explicitly selected

route_gates.standard_required_inputs: WTR-111 core + baseline usable capacity + post-intervention usable capacity
Structure + Technical capacity geometry; no daily rainfall/catchment/hydro simulation
Capacity difference inputs; no daily rainfall simulation
Verified desilted volume; no daily rainfall simulation

route_gates.core_rules: VAL-021..024, VAL-032..039 as applicable, VAL-073, VAL-085, VAL-089, VAL-092
route_gates.standard_required_inputs: Farm Pond + Fully lined + proper inlet/outlet + prerequisite catchment/rainfall evidence + eligible capacity route
Recognized structure identity and Partly lined status
Person-day rows with category-specific fields and deduplication keys

rules.validation_logic: Template Version must equal a supported schema version; v1 standard = HUF-SS-INPUT-v1.1.
rules.remediation: Use a supported template or migrate the workbook.

rules.validation_logic: Exactly one nonblank reporting-run row is permitted in 01_Control.
rules.remediation: Keep one reporting run per workbook.

rules.validation_logic: Project ID must be nonblank.
Reporting Start Date and Reporting End Date must be valid dates and Start <= End.
Standard reporting FY must start on 01-Apr and end on 31-Mar of the following calendar year.
rules.remediation: Use 01-Apr to 31-Mar for the reporting FY.

rules.validation_logic: Generate expected dates by actual calendar iteration from Start through End inclusive; do not use a fixed 365-day constant.
rules.source_refs: D2 EVP-001 calendar note; validated leap/non-leap samples

rules.validation_logic: Expected day count must equal inclusive calendar days; for standard 1-Apr–31-Mar FY it will be 365 or 366.
29-Feb is required only when it actually falls inside the reporting FY; it must never be synthesized for a non-leap calendar year.
rules.remediation: Correct calendar generation; do not manually force Feb-29.

rules.validation_logic: Formula Catalog Version must be supported; v1.1 standard = HUF-DESIGN2-FORMULA-CATALOG-v1.1.
rules.remediation: Select/migrate to a supported formula catalog.

rules.validation_logic: Capacity Catalog Version must be supported by the app configuration.
Resolved area method must be one of Standard simple or Advanced stage-area; structure override, if present, supersedes Control default.
A controlled DDW/Runoff Method must be selected. Calibrated approved model requires a Calibration ID; legacy-v1 fallback is allowed but flagged.
rules.remediation: Select a method; provide Calibration ID when calibrated method is used.

rules.validation_logic: Legacy-v1 fallback does not block calculation but adds a methodological warning to all dependent WTR-111 results.
rules.remediation: Use calibrated approved model to remove the warning.

rules.validation_logic: Structure Record ID must be nonblank and unique.

rules.applies_to: All child sheets with record IDs
rules.validation_logic: Record IDs within each child table must be unique where the sheet defines an ID field.
Every Structure Record ID reference must resolve to 02_Structures.
TEC Rainfall Station ID must resolve to at least one rainfall row for that Station ID.
rules.remediation: Provide rainfall rows or correct Station ID.

rules.validation_logic: Hydro Parameter Group ID must resolve to exactly one Hydro Params row.
Stage-Area Group ID is required and must resolve to stage-area observations.
rules.remediation: Provide Stage-Area Group ID and observations or use Standard simple method.

rules.validation_logic: Related Record ID should resolve to the declared related record type. Orphan supporting evidence is flagged but does not block unrelated calculations.
Structure Type must map to the frozen Design 1 structure map or be a controlled excluded type.
rules.remediation: Map to a controlled structure type.

rules.validation_logic: Intervention Type must be New construction, Rejuvenation/repair, or Governance-related.
Lining Status must be controlled and sufficient to distinguish Unlined, Fully lined, Partly lined, or Not applicable.
Completion Date is required for timing classification and first-monsoon/silt logic.

rules.trigger: When resolved timing method = Strict cutoff
rules.validation_logic: Completion Date <= Configured Cutoff routes eligible surface intervention to KPI 1.1.1; Completion Date > cutoff routes to KPI 1.1.2, subject to route eligibility.
rules.remediation: Correct dates or timing method if route is unexpected.

rules.trigger: When resolved timing method = Actual functional date - partial season
rules.validation_logic: Functional Date is required, must be >= Completion Date, and must be <= Reporting End Date. Simulation begins max(Functional Date, Reporting Start Date).
rules.remediation: Enter/correct Functional Date or use Strict cutoff.

rules.validation_logic: Strict cutoff and partial-season timing must never both be applied to the same structure/run.
Automatic water-potential route = WTR-EXCL-GOV. Person-days remain independently assessable.

rules.trigger: When Structure Type = subsurface recharge excluded type
rules.validation_logic: Automatic water-potential route = WTR-EXCL-SUB in v1.1.
rules.remediation: No automatic water calculation unless a future approved version changes the route.

rules.validation_logic: Automatic compliant water route = WTR-HOLD-PARTLY-LINED; numeric water result is not calculated.
rules.remediation: Await an approved partly-lined physical method.

rules.trigger: When Structure Type = Other approved surface structure
rules.validation_logic: Eligibility Approval Evidence ID must resolve to Available/verified eligibility/method approval evidence.
rules.remediation: Provide verified approval evidence or exclude the record.

rules.validation_logic: Exactly one Rejuvenation Method must be selected: post-minus-baseline or verified desilted volume.
Baseline Usable Capacity and Post-intervention Usable Capacity must both be present and >=0; eligible increment=max(0,post-baseline).

rules.trigger: When Rejuvenation Method = verified desilted volume
rules.validation_logic: Verified Desilted Volume must be present and >=0.
REJ-A and REJ-B must never be summed or simultaneously used for the same work scope/run.

rules.trigger: When active capacity family requires a geometry field
rules.validation_logic: Required Length/Width-or-Backwater/Height/Depth/Distance inputs must be numeric and >0; Effective Length Fraction must be >0 and <=1.
High Elevation, Low Elevation, Horizontal Distance and Height/Depth must be present; High > Low and Distance >0.
rules.remediation: Provide valid slope inputs or measured backwater.

rules.validation_logic: Structure Type must resolve to a frozen capacity family/factor and the active Capacity Catalog Version must be attached to the result lineage.

rules.trigger: When Recorded Physical Capacity is provided
rules.validation_logic: Compare recorded capacity to calculated gross/net capacity; material variance is warning-only unless an explicit approved precedence method is selected.
rules.remediation: Review geometry/MB/design or document the variance.

rules.validation_logic: Exactly one applicable Catchment record must resolve for each WTR-111 structure.
Method 1 requires Free Catchment and relevant cascade links; Method 2 requires Free + Intercepted; Method 3 requires Free; farm pond/bund alternate requires verified higher-elevation adjoining area.
rules.remediation: Complete the fields required by the selected catchment method.

rules.validation_logic: Catchment and overlap areas must be >=0; required effective catchment must be >0 for WTR-111.
Upstream->downstream graph must be acyclic. A cycle blocks only the affected connected cascade network.
rules.remediation: Correct cascade links to remove the cycle.

rules.validation_logic: Upstream and downstream Structure Record IDs must both exist and must not be the same record.
There must be at most one rainfall observation per Station ID + Date.
Date must be a valid calendar date. Invalid dates are not coerced.
Daily Rainfall must be numeric and >=0. A true no-rain day is explicit 0.
Blank/null rainfall or a missing station-date is missing data and must never be silently replaced with 0.
rules.remediation: Supply the missing observation or keep affected calculation not-ready.

rules.trigger: Per Station ID used by WTR-111
rules.validation_logic: Compare station dates with the leap-aware expected FY calendar. Full-FY coverage metric is reported; a missing date blocks only linked structures whose actual simulation window includes that date.
rules.remediation: Supply missing dates for the affected simulation window.

rules.trigger: When station has rows outside reporting FY
rules.validation_logic: Dates outside Reporting Start..End are excluded from the active series and flagged; they do not block valid in-window data.
Structure Latitude/Longitude and Station Latitude/Longitude must all be present and within valid coordinate ranges.
rules.remediation: Provide valid coordinates or choose another documented source method.

rules.trigger: When source method = Same hydrological/administrative zone
rules.validation_logic: Structure Zone and Station Zone must both be nonblank and match after controlled normalization.
rules.remediation: Correct zone values or choose another source method.

rules.trigger: When source method = Documented expert selection
rules.validation_logic: Rainfall Source Rationale must be nonblank.
Hydro Parameter Group ID must be nonblank and unique.
rules.remediation: Correct duplicate/missing Hydro Parameter Group ID.

rules.trigger: When WTR-111 + Unlined + resolved area method = Standard simple
rules.validation_logic: Verified Base Area must be numeric and >0.
rules.remediation: Enter one verified Base Area in m2.

rules.trigger: When Full Surface Area and Verified Base Area both available
rules.validation_logic: Verified Base Area must be <= Full Surface Area within tolerance.
Infiltration Rate must be numeric, >=0, and interpreted as canonical mm/hour in the standard v1.1 workbook.
Out-of-band infiltration rate is not automatically rejected if nonnegative, but requires review/source evidence.
rules.remediation: Confirm the rate/source or correct it.

rules.validation_logic: Jan through Dec Mean Daily Evaporation must all be present, numeric and >=0; standard unit is mm/day.
rules.remediation: Enter all 12 monthly mean daily evaporation values.

rules.validation_logic: Daily evaporation rate = monthly mean daily evaporation for date.month. 29-Feb uses February value; non-leap years have no 29-Feb lookup.
rules.remediation: Correct calendar/month mapping if mismatch occurs.

rules.trigger: When monthly mean daily evaporation >20 mm/day
rules.validation_logic: Very high monthly mean daily evaporation is warning-only and requires source review.

Use measured Full Surface Area when present; otherwise GEO-004 may derive a traceable storage-plan area only where the active geometry route supports it. If neither source is valid, affected structure is not-ready.
rules.remediation: Provide Full Surface Area or valid geometry for derived plan area.

rules.validation_logic: Evaporation Area = Full Surface Area × Fill Fraction; require 0<=Fill Fraction<=1 and 0<=Evaporation Area<=Full Surface Area.
At least two valid observations are required; depth must be strictly increasing after sort, no duplicate depths, areas >=0.
rules.remediation: Correct/add stage-area observations or switch to Standard simple.

rules.validation_logic: Water Surface Area should be nondecreasing with depth; decrease requires documented geometry exception.

rules.trigger: When storage is outside validated stage-storage curve
rules.validation_logic: Do not silently extrapolate stage. Advanced method becomes not-ready for the affected structure unless switched to Standard simple.
rules.remediation: Extend the curve or use Standard simple.

rules.trigger: When derived first monsoon since construction/reset
rules.validation_logic: Applied silt rate = 0%. Conflicting entered silt assessment is ignored for calculation and flagged.
Original Depth and D1..D5 must all be present and >0.
rules.remediation: Complete all five depth observations and original depth.

rules.validation_logic: Applied silt rate = clamp((OriginalDepth - mean(D1..D5))/OriginalDepth, 0, 1). Negative raw loss is flagged for review; applied rate cannot exceed 100%.

rules.trigger: When Assessment Method = Year-3 cumulative assumption
rules.validation_logic: Prior Year-2 Silt Rate must be present, numeric and within 0..100%.

rules.trigger: When Assessment Method = Surveyed volume loss
rules.validation_logic: Surveyed Volume Loss must be >=0 and must not exceed Gross Capacity beyond tolerance.

rules.trigger: When Last Desilting/Repair Date is used to reset silt age
rules.validation_logic: Reset is permitted only with verified repair/desilting evidence. Without it, do not apply reset.
rules.remediation: Provide verified reset evidence or remove/reset the date.

rules.validation_logic: Proper Inlet = Yes, Proper Outlet = Yes, and required catchment/rainfall evidence must be Available/verified.

Missing ordinary supporting evidence does not erase a valid numeric result; it produces an assurance warning for E07. Eligibility/method-defining evidence remains governed by its specific blocking rule.
rules.remediation: Attach supporting evidence for accepted/certified assurance.

rules.validation_logic: If Evidence Status = Available/verified, Evidence Reference must be nonblank. Pending may have blank reference.
rules.remediation: Add evidence reference or correct status.

rules.validation_logic: Person-Day Record ID must be nonblank and unique.
Date must be valid and fall within the reporting FY for annual KPI 1.2.1.
rules.remediation: Correct the date or exclude the row from this reporting run.

rules.validation_logic: Verified Direct Person-Days must be numeric and >=0; Participant ID/Name and Date are required for person-level dedupe.
Hours Worked must be numeric and >=0; person-days = Hours/8; Participant ID/Name and Date required.
Work Quantity >0, Quantity Unit controlled, Productivity Norm >0; person-days=Quantity/Productivity.
Machinery Support Role is required and exactly one labor basis is supplied: Hours Worked or Verified Direct Person-Days. Machine output itself is excluded.
rules.remediation: Provide role and one labor basis only.

rules.validation_logic: Duplicate key = normalized Participant + Date + Structure/Work ID + Work Scope/Activity. Duplicate rows block only the conflicting person-day claims.

rules.trigger: Within same Structure/Work ID + Work Scope/Activity
rules.validation_logic: A volume-based estimate must not coexist with direct paid/community/machinery labor claims for the same work scope unless explicitly split into non-overlapping subscopes.
rules.remediation: Use direct evidence or volume estimate for a scope, not both.

rules.validation_logic: Water-route errors must not block otherwise valid person-day records; person-day errors must not block independent water calculations.
Blank/null remains null. Only an explicit source value of 0 becomes numeric zero.
rules.remediation: Provide missing required data; do not zero-fill.

rules.validation_logic: Generated, Opening, Overflow, Evaporation, Infiltration and Closing must be >= -tolerance; Opening/Closing must not exceed eligible capacity beyond tolerance.
rules.remediation: Treat as calculation-engine/data error and suppress official result.

rules.validation_logic: abs(PreviousClosing + Generated - Overflow - Evaporation - Infiltration - Closing) <= max(1e-6,1e-9*scale).
rules.remediation: Suppress affected official result and inspect calculation trace.

rules.validation_logic: abs((Cumulative Infiltration + Final Closing) - (Captured Runoff - Cumulative Evaporation)) <= numerical tolerance.
rules.remediation: Suppress affected KPI and inspect daily balance.

rules.validation_logic: Do not round intermediate values; publication rounding applies only to display/export formatting.
Accepted/certified, provisional/evidence-pending, calculated-warning, not-calculated/hold, and excluded quantities/counts must remain separately reported; do not mix held/excluded into water totals.
Every eligible source record must reconcile into exactly one aggregation-status bucket; counts must match source-level routing/readiness inventory.
If route is excluded => excluded; partly-lined => hold; any active scoped blocker => not_ready; otherwise warning(s) => ready_with_warning; otherwise => ready.
rules.remediation: Resolve blocking issues or review warnings.

rules.validation_logic: A rainfall-series blocker propagates only to structures linked to that station whose simulation window intersects the bad/missing date(s). KPI 1.1.2, lined single-fill and person-days remain independent.
rules.remediation: Repair affected series; independent modules continue.

rules.validation_logic: Block only structures in the affected connected cascade component and dependent downstream chain. Independent catchments/routes continue.
Numerically ready calculations remain calculable; downstream assurance becomes provisional/evidence-pending unless a specific eligibility/method prerequisite rule says evidence is blocking.
